note: Advisories npm audit reports that are accepted for now, each with why and until when. scripts/check-audit.mjs fails on any high or critical advisory not listed here, and on any entry past its expiry, so an exception is looked at again rather than forgotten.

exceptions.reason: Reached only through development tools (eslint-config-next > fast-glob > micromatch, knip, vitest and vite), which match this repo's own glob patterns, never input from a player or the network; `npm ls picomatch --omit=dev` is empty, so the server and the apps ship none. No patched picomatch exists: the advisory covers every release up to 4.0.7, the newest.
